retrievalProfile.description: A multi-layered layout featuring a central torn-edge photograph framed within a solid border, set against a ruled-paper background with postage-stamp corner accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex graphic composition utilizing a cream-colored ruled paper texture as a base, featuring a dark brown square frame containing a portrait with white deckled/torn edges. The layout is anchored by circular stamp motifs in the top corners and technical audio logos in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait nested within a dark frame and white torn-edge mask
Symmetrical stamp placement at the top header
Horizontal ruled lines providing a subtle texture to the background
Contrast between organic torn paper edges and geometric framing
coreInvariants: Torn-edge white border around the central image
Cream background with thin horizontal blue/green ruled lines
Dark brown or black primary frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait occupying the middle 60% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark square frame that contains the portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top stamps, moves down to the central face, and finishes at the technical text in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored space at the top and sides of the central frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast portrait against muted, low-saturation background textures.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mix of script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script text appears as if handwritten on a separate torn paper scrap
Technical text uses blocky, high-density geometric forms
Stamp text follows a circular path
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking 'disc' lettering for the technical logo

composition.relationshipToImage: floating on a torn paper scrap

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Handwritten script for personality paired with rigid geometric sans for technical specifications.

preserve: Torn paper scrap for the name

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual handwritten feel of the name label
Matches the technical 'compact disc' logo aesthetic

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored background with thin horizontal blue ruled lines. Place a dark brown square frame in the center. Inside the frame, place a portrait with a white, irregular torn-paper edge. Add two postage stamps with perforated edges in the top corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small cyan torn paper scrap over the top-right of the portrait. Place script text on the scrap. Add red technical block text in the bottom right corner of the dark frame.

verificationChecks: Is the central photo edge visibly 'torn' and white?
Are the background lines horizontal and subtle?
Is the technical text in the bottom right high-contrast red?

mustAchieve: Visible deckled edges on the photo

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'torn paper' artifacts around the photo
Verify ruled lines do not overlap the central frame
Confirm the script text looks like a separate physical label
recipe.reuseFormula: Ruled Background + Framed Torn-Edge Photo + Symmetrical Stamp Header + Technical Corner Metadata
